build_hisparse_coordinator: build a HiSparseCoordinator instance to manage device-host KV cache swapping for speculative decoding
admit_request_into_staging: admit a request into staging by backing up prefill tokens from device to host memory pool
swap_in_selected_pages: swap in top-k selected tokens from host cache into device memory using a JIT CUDA kernel
grow_device_buffers: grow device buffers for requests whose sequence length exceeds current buffer capacity
collect_ready_reqs: collect requests that finished staging and are ready for decode with allocated device buffers
